text:
Priya Singh: Hey team — can we run a quick smoke + cost-latency sweep for sweetwater-6b-v1? Need baseline before canary. Target seq=512, 8 concurrent reqs. Any objections?
Evan Li: 👍 no objections. I'll queue it but need GPU capacity window. When do you need results?
Priya Singh: End of day would be ideal, but EOD PST is fine. Also want tail latency (p95/p99) and mem usage, and any microburst.
bench-bot: queued sweetwater-6b-v1 | seq=512 | conc=8 | env=staging | run_id=sw6b-202603
bench-bot: preliminary: throughput=980 tok/s, avg_latency=210ms, p95=480ms, p99=920ms, gpu_mem=12.2GB (peak)
Marta K.: looked at traces — noticing small KV cache misses at step ~120. Those align with the p99 spikes.
Marta K.: quick profile link: https://internal.redwood/bench/sw6b-202603/profile (nano sample)
Evan Li: can you paste the flame snippet? curious if attention kernels stutter or CUDA scheduling
Marta K.: flame snippet:
```
func attention_forward  42%
kernel matmul_az  18%
kv_cache_update  9%
dispatch_overhead  5%
```
Marta K.: looks like matmul fragmentation + occasional syncs. I'll run a tiled matmul patch next.
Joseph R.: FYI — if p99 stays >800ms we should gate canary. I'll hold the rollout unless we see <700ms p99 after patch.
Priya Singh: noted. Can we get a quick dequant test too? Might reduce mem by ~2GB and improve perf.
bench-bot: dequant sweep queued: deq=8bit | run_id=sw6b-deq-202603
bench-bot: deq results: throughput=1180 tok/s, avg_latency=175ms, p95=390ms, p99=760ms, gpu_mem=10.1GB
Evan Li: dequant helps a lot on tail — still a p99 at 760ms but much better. Any quality regression checks?
Marta K.: ran eval set A (1000 prompts) — rouge/bert scores within 0.6% of fp16 baseline. no red flags.
Priya Singh: ok sounds promising. Plan: Marta to land tiled matmul patch + re-run smoke, Evan to validate canary config, Joseph to hold canary until p99<700ms OR we toggle dequant by default.
Marta K.: I'll open PR and tag @Evan for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/489
ops-jen: created ticket INF-3241 to track follow-ups and canary gating. Assigned to Marta, Evan, Joseph.
Joseph R.: thanks — if PR lands and dequant improves p99 to <700ms, I'll approve canary. Else we'll schedule another perf slot.
Priya Singh: thanks all. I'll update the onboarding doc with these numbers. Quick note: add cost estimate per 1M tokens in doc.
Evan Li: can someone add the cost calc? quick formula we use: cost = (gpu_hour_rate / tokens_per_hour)
Marta K.: added cost snippet in doc and pinned it. :thumbsup:
bench-bot: summary artifact: https://internal.redwood/bench/sw6b-202603/report.json
Priya Singh: closing the loop — will post final decision tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :rocket:
